faq.q: What is the NAATI CCL test?
faq.a: The Credentialed Community Language (CCL) test checks your ability to interpret dialogues between an English speaker and a speaker of your community language. It is marked out of 90, and each of the two dialogues is marked out of 45.
English paired with Filipino, Hindi, Mandarin, Punjabi, Arabic, Nepali and Vietnamese. More languages can be added.

Your recording is transcribed and each Meaning Unit of the segment is checked for omissions, insertions and distortions (1 point each). Language quality and fluency issues cost 0.5 points per occurrence. Pauses and start delays are measured from your audio.

faq.q: What do I need to take a mock test?
faq.a: A computer with a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, headphones or speakers, and a microphone. The player includes an equipment check before you start.

faq.q: Can I try it before I pay?
faq.a: Yes. Create a free account to open the introduction course and a free practice dialogue.
No. Results are estimated scores to guide your preparation. Only NAATI issues official CCL results.

sections.heading: About these terms
sections.body: These terms apply to your use of the Benchmark Education CCL practice platform. By creating an account you agree to them.

sections.heading: Your account
sections.body: Keep your login details private. Accounts are for one person and must not be shared.

sections.heading: Plans and payments
sections.body: Paid plans are billed through Stripe. You can manage or cancel a subscription from your account page. Access to paid content ends when your plan ends.

sections.heading: Practice content
sections.body: Dialogues, audio, courses and feedback are for your personal preparation. Do not copy, record, share or resell them.

sections.heading: Estimated scores
sections.body: Scores are estimates produced to help you practise. They are not NAATI results and do not guarantee any outcome in the real test.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms can be sent to Benchmark Education.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Your name, email address, payment status (payments are processed by Stripe; we do not store card details), your practice attempts, voice recordings and their transcripts.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: To run your account, score your practice attempts, show you feedback, send transactional emails (welcome, receipts, password resets, results) and improve the platform.

sections.heading: Service providers
sections.body: Recordings are transcribed and evaluated by AI service providers, and stored with a cloud storage provider. Payments are handled by Stripe.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can ask us to access, correct or delete your personal information.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Privacy questions can be sent to Benchmark Education.
